body.zh-Hant: 艾哈邁德·陶菲克帕夏1845年2月10日生於伊斯坦堡于斯屈達爾，出身克里米亞汗室後裔的家族。他早年入軍職，後以健康為由辭去，1866年起在高門翻譯室任職，1872年出任駐羅馬使館二等秘書，其後歷任維也納、柏林、雅典等地使館職務，1885年10月11日被任命為駐柏林大使，任職十年，1895年被召回伊斯坦堡，出任外交大臣。
body.en: Ahmed Tevfik Pasha was born in Üsküdar, Istanbul, on 10 February 1845, into a family descended from the Crimean khans. He left military service, citing health reasons, and from 1866 worked at the Translation Office of the Sublime Porte. In 1872 he became second secretary at the Rome embassy and then held posts in Vienna, Berlin and Athens. On 11 October 1885 he was appointed ambassador to Berlin, serving ten years before returning to Istanbul in 1895 as Minister of Foreign Affairs.

heading.en: Over a decade as Foreign Minister

body.zh-Hant: 1895年11月6日，他在卡米勒帕夏政府中就任外交大臣，任期直到1909年2月卡米勒帕夏辭職、內閣解散為止，前後長達十三年以上。1897年結束奧斯曼—希臘戰爭的和約由時任外交大臣的他簽署。1908年他在外交大臣之外又獲任奧斯曼上議院（Meclis-i A‘yân）議員。學者另指出，他沒有加入任何政黨，也未在外交系統之外擔任過其他官職。
body.en: On 6 November 1895 he took office as Foreign Minister in Kâmil Pasha's government and remained until Kâmil Pasha resigned and the cabinet broke up in February 1909, a tenure of more than thirteen years. The peace treaty ending the 1897 Ottoman-Greek war was signed by him as the then Foreign Minister. In 1908 he was also given membership of the Ottoman Senate (Meclis-i A‘yân) alongside the ministry. Scholars add that he joined no political party and held no Ottoman bureaucratic post other than in the foreign service.

heading.zh-Hant: 首度大宰相與駐倫敦大使
heading.en: First grand vizierate and the London embassy

body.zh-Hant: 三月三十一日事件之後，他於1909年4月出任大宰相，卻因蘇丹阿卜杜勒哈米德二世被廢、穆罕默德五世即位而於5月去職。研究指出，他辭任大宰相後第四天即被任命為駐倫敦大使，這一職務一直做到1914年第一次世界大戰開始為止。
body.en: After the 31 March Incident he became grand vizier in April 1909, but he left office in May when Abdulhamid II was deposed and Mehmed V came to the throne. One study says he was appointed ambassador to London on the fourth day after resigning as grand vizier, and he kept that post until the First World War began in 1914.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰後大宰相、最後內閣與晚年
heading.en: Post-war grand vizier, the last cabinet and later life

body.zh-Hant: 他於1918年11月11日接替辭職的伊澤特帕夏再任大宰相，1920年10月21日組成奧斯曼帝國最後一屆內閣。1921年2月至3月的倫敦會議上，他表示發言權應屬民族代表，而將位置讓給安卡拉方面。1922年蘇丹制被廢除後他辭職，其後未在土耳其共和國擔任任何職務，並依姓氏法取姓Okday。他於1936年10月去世。
body.en: He was appointed grand vizier again on 11 November 1918 in place of the resigning Izzet Pasha, and on 21 October 1920 he formed the last cabinet of the Ottoman state. At the London conference of February-March 1921 he said that the floor belonged to the national deputies and left the speaking position to the Ankara delegation. After the sultanate was abolished in 1922 he resigned, took no post in the Turkish Republic and adopted the surname Okday. He died in October 1936.

body.zh-Hant: 尼爾斯·埃登1871年8月25日生於北博滕省皮特奧，父親是中學校長佩爾·奧洛夫·埃登。他1899年5月10日通過博士論文答辯，同月26日任烏普薩拉大學歷史講師，1903年底成為額外教授。他的主要史學著作研究瑞典官僚國家的奠基與成長。1908年他被推為烏普薩拉左翼協會主席，並獲提名為第二院選舉候選人。
body.en: Nils Edén was born at Piteå in Norrbotten on 25 August 1871, the son of the school rector Per Olof Edén. He defended his doctoral thesis on 10 May 1899, became a docent in history at Uppsala on 26 May and an extraordinary professor at the end of 1903. His main historical work concerned the foundation and growth of the Swedish civil-service state. In 1908 he was elected chairman of the Uppsala left-wing association and nominated as its candidate for the second chamber.

heading.zh-Hant: 議會與自由黨領袖之路
heading.en: Parliament and the road to Liberal leadership

body.zh-Hant: 自1909年起，埃登擔任議會第二院議員，至1924年；1913至1917年任憲法委員會主席。1912年他應施塔夫提議獲選為自由黨第二院黨團主席。1915年施塔夫去世後，自由黨領導問題成為焦點，1916年議會初期以五人委員會領導，他入選其中，並被視為黨內首要人物。
body.en: From 1909 Edén sat in the second chamber of the Riksdag until 1924, and from 1913 to 1917 he chaired the Constitutional Committee. In 1912, on Staaff's proposal, he was elected chairman of the Liberal group in the second chamber. After Staaff died in 1915 the question of the Liberal leadership became dominant; at the start of the 1916 Riksdag the party was placed under a council of five, to which Edén was elected, and he stood out as the party's foremost man.

body.zh-Hant: 1917年10月19日，埃登組閣並出任首相（Statsminister），任期至1920年3月10日；SBL稱其內閣的成立標誌著瑞典議會制的最終突破。1918年起他並任自由黨主席。在他任內，瑞典完成了政治民主的改革；1920年他參與起草並在議會推動瑞典加入國際聯盟的議案。1920年初內閣因執政各黨之間的對立而解散。
body.en: On 19 October 1917 Edén formed a government and became prime minister (Statsminister), serving until 10 March 1920; the SBL says his ministry marked the definitive breakthrough of parliamentarism in Sweden. From 1918 he was also chairman of the Liberal party. Under him political democracy was carried through in Sweden, and in 1920 he helped draft and pushed through the proposal for Swedish accession to the League of Nations. The cabinet had to be dissolved in early 1920 because of conflicts between the governing parties.

heading.en: Party split, county governor and later life

body.zh-Hant: 1923年5月27日的自由黨臨時全國會議上，主張禁酒的多數派通過其立場，埃登所代表的反對方當天即在他主持下集會，準備組建新的自由黨組織；1924年任期屆滿後他離開議會，此後二十多年不再參與政治工作。1920年12月3日至1938年8月31日他擔任斯德哥爾摩省省長，其間仍從事史學著述。他於1945年6月16日在斯德哥爾摩去世。
body.en: At an extraordinary Liberal party congress on 27 May 1923 the majority favouring prohibition prevailed, and the same day the opposing side met under Edén's chairmanship to prepare a new Liberal party formation. When his mandate ended in 1924 he left the Riksdag and for the rest of his life, more than twenty years, stayed outside political work. From 3 December 1920 to 31 August 1938 he was governor of Stockholm County, continuing historical writing during that time. He died in Stockholm on 16 June 1945.

body.zh-Hant: 1924年10月，尼加拉瓜舉行總統、副總統與國會議員選舉，結果由保守黨人與自由黨人組成的聯合候選組合當選。柯立芝總統咨文稱卡洛斯·索洛薩諾為保守共和派（Conservative Republican），他當選總統；自由黨人胡安·B·薩卡薩當選副總統。這個政府獲得其他中美洲國家與美國承認。
body.en: In October 1924 Nicaragua held an election for President, Vice President and members of Congress, and a coalition ticket embracing Conservatives and Liberals won. President Coolidge's message calls Carlos Solórzano a Conservative Republican, who was elected President, while the Liberal Juan B. Sacasa was elected Vice President. This government was recognized by the other Central American countries and by the United States.

heading.zh-Hant: 海軍陸戰隊撤出與洛馬事件
heading.en: Withdrawal of the marines and the Loma seizure

body.zh-Hant: 美國原擬於1925年1月撤出駐尼加拉瓜的海軍陸戰隊，應尼加拉瓜總統的請求，期限延至1925年9月1日；陸戰隊實際在1925年8月撤出，當時看來局勢已趨平穩。但不到兩個月，查莫羅將軍的支持者與總統的支持者之間再起騷亂，最後查莫羅於10月25日佔領俯瞰馬那瓜的洛馬要塞。
body.en: The United States had meant to withdraw its marines from Nicaragua in January 1925; at the request of the Nicaraguan President the date was extended to 1 September 1925, and the marines were in fact withdrawn in August 1925, when tranquillity seemed assured. Within two months, however, further disturbances broke out between the supporters of General Chamorro and the supporters of the President, culminating in the seizure of the Loma, a fortress dominating Managua, which Chamorro took on 25 October.

heading.zh-Hant: 查莫羅的協議與索洛薩諾辭職

body.zh-Hant: 查莫羅控制洛馬後，擬定一項協議，總統隔天簽署：總統同意以查莫羅的支持者替換部分內閣成員，付給查莫羅一萬美元的起事費用，並赦免參與者。副總統薩卡薩隨即離開該國。查莫羅另使國會逐出十八名議員，並於1926年1月16日由國會任命為代理人；同日索洛薩諾辭去總統職務，查莫羅隨即就任。美國與中美洲四國拒絕承認查莫羅為總統。
body.en: Once in possession of the Loma, Chamorro dictated an agreement that President Solórzano signed the next day: he agreed to replace certain cabinet members with Chamorro's supporters, to pay Chamorro $10,000 for the costs of the uprising and to grant amnesty to its participants. Vice President Sacasa then left the country. Chamorro also had 18 members expelled from Congress and was appointed designate by Congress on 16 January 1926; the same day Solórzano resigned as President and Chamorro immediately took office. The United States and four Central American countries refused to recognize him as President.
